_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Mukutembenuza Klondike Solitaire. Cholinga chanu ndi kuyenda kadi zonse ku foundation piles.

Mwendo wa Mpira:
- Foundation piles (F1-F4): Munda kadi kuchoka Ace mpaka King mu suit
- Tableau piles (T1-T7): Munda kadi kuchoka mwamba, kuyenda m'ma oneka (red pa black, black pa red)
- Stock: Draw kadi ku waste pile
- Waste (W): Kadi ya juu iliyo wapya kwa mpira

Maagizo:
- 'draw' - Draw kadi kuchoka stock ku waste
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Yasogola kadi pakati pa piles
  Zitsanzo: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count inaweza kuwa 'all', yomwe itayesera kuyenda kadi zonse.
- 'forfeit' - Maliza mpira mwamsanga na kuyika pa score yanu
- Maima a piles: W (waste), F1-F4 (foundations), T1-T7 (tableau)

Mungathe kuyendetsa zinthu zingapo pa mpinda mmoja kwa kuzigawanya ndi commas:
  Zitsanzo: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Kings pekee ndi amene angaweza kuwekwa pa tableau piles.
Zinthu zikuyendetsa m'mwendo - ngati chimodzi chayele, zinthu zinazosala zikuyimiridwa.
Gwiritsani 'forfeit' ngati mukuganiza kuti mpira siyina mpata.

format_error.no_brackets: Mawonekedwe a zochita zosagwira ntchito. Zochita ziyenera kukhala m'malimagulu.
format_error.no_closing_bracket: Mawonekedwe a chochitika chosagwira ntchito. Kusowa kwa bracket yotseka ']'
format_error.move_needs_args: Agizo la move likufuna source ndi destination. Mtundikano: 'move <source> <destination> [count]'
format_error.count_positive: Nambari ya count iyenera kuwa chanya kapena 'all'
format_error.count_invalid: Nambari ya count siyo ya bwino. Gwiritsani nambari kapena 'all'

move_result.cannot_draw: Sitingathe kukoka, sitikhala ndi katundu kapena zinyalala.

move_result.tableau_to_foundation_ok: Tinamiza kadi ku tableau T{src} ku foundation F{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_bad: Simungathe kusuntha khadi la tableau ku mulu wa mazikowo
move_result.foundation_to_foundation: Sangasinthe kuchokera ku maziko kupita kumalo ena
move_result.waste_to_tableau_one_card: Mungasinthe khadi limodzi lokha kuchoka ku zinyalala kupita pa tebulo
move_result.waste_to_tableau_ok: Kusamutsidwa khadi kuchokera zinyalala kwa tableau T{dst}
move_result.waste_to_tableau_bad: Simungathe kuika khadi la zinyalala pa mulu wa tableau umenewo
move_result.no_face_up: Palibe makadi oyang'ana mmwamba oti asunthidwe.
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_ok: Tinamiza {count} kadi(s) ku tableau T{src} ku T{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_bad: Siyikufunika kunamiza {count} kadi(s) ku T{src} ku T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_one_card: Mungasinthe khadi limodzi lokha kuchokera ku maziko kupita pa tebulo
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_ok: Tinamiza kadi ku foundation F{src} ku tableau T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_bad: Sangathe kuika maziko khadi pa tableau T{dst}
move_result.to_waste_or_stock: Sangathe kusamutsidwa ku zinyalala kapena katundu.

outcome.forfeit: Masewerawa anathamangitsidwa. Zotsatira zomaliza: {score} makadi pamaziko.
outcome.won: Tikukuyamikirani, mwapambana pa mpikisano wa Klondike Solitaire!
outcome.turn_limit: Mchezo umemalizika! Umefikia kiwango cha juu cha {max_turns} mizunguko. Alama: {score} kadi katika msingi.
